Lisa Wolff

Our Senior counselor, Lisa Wolff has been practicing since 2016. She understands that making the decision to start psychotherapy can be difficult for some people. Therefore, she strives to create a safe and welcoming environment for the healing process to take place. Moreover, She works in collaboration with clients in creating personalized plans for therapy to aid clients in reaching their goals. She utilizes a range of therapeutic approaches that are empirically supported to help clients achieve their goals for therapy. Such approaches include Self-care, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Mindfulness, Dialectical Behavioral Therapy, Person Centered Therapy, Motivational Interviewing, and Spiritual Integrated Therapy (if desired). She hold a Master of Science in Mental Health and Pastoral Counseling from the Loyola University of Maryland and is a Licensed Clinical Professional Counselor in the state of Maryland.

Experience: 9 Years

License: State of Maryland LC9061

Education: Howard University (MAT / 1997)
Loyola University of Maryland, Masters of Science in Mental Health/Pastoral Counseling (2016)

Dr. Rhonda J. Beckwith

I specialize in mental health and substance abuse (opioid/ alcohol), sexual trauma, aging, bullying, anger management, career counseling, depression, relationships, LGBTQ issues, self-image, stress, and suicide. I use Process Oriented Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Motivational Interviewing, Mindfulness Practices, and Solution Focused modalities.

License: Licensed by State of Maryland / LC12868

Education: Doctor of Psychology

Jenell Crumpley

Healing starts with understanding your own story.

At our practice, we believe in a personalized approach to therapy, recognizing that there’s no one-size-fits-all solution. Whether you’re dealing with chronic pain, depression, PTSD, anxiety, or other challenges, we’re here to help. Our goal is to help you find your strengths and develop new coping strategies.

Using person-centered, strengths-based, and cognitive-behavioral interventions, we’ll work together to set and achieve your goals. We focus on helping you process your thoughts, feelings, and beliefs to create a plan that works for you.

Experience: 9 Years

License: Licensed by State of Maryland / LGP13516

Education: Degree/Diploma from Liberty University M. Ed / 2020
Degree/Diploma from Bowie State University B.S. Psychology / 1996
Attended Medaille College, M.A. Mental Health Counseling, Graduated 2012

Emmanuel Smith

I’m here to help you become happy, healthy, and whole.

At Mercy Cares Counseling Services Counseling, I offer a safe, non-judgmental space where you can heal, grow, and thrive. I lean into the spiritual nature of the counseling process to help you become the best version of yourself.

I specialize in mood disorders, anxiety, depression, ADHD, spiritual issues, men’s issues, and couples counseling. Life can be overwhelming, but I’m here to help you navigate your challenges and achieve your goals. If you’re feeling stuck, let’s get started on your journey to a better you. You are worth it!
